name: The Conjecture Inn
description: The Conjecture Inn is an online forum devoted to mathematical discussion across pure and applied areas. Members post conjectures they find interesting, attempt proofs, search for counterexamples, debate which formulations are most natural, and occasionally argue about what a proof even is. The forum has sections for Open Conjectures, Proof Attempts, Counterexamples, Refactorings, Foundations & Methodology, and Off-Topic. The tone runs from tersely formal to discursively philosophical depending on the poster. All members are professional or serious-amateur mathematicians, mostly based in research universities and mathematics-adjacent industry across the US, UK, and Europe in 2026.
default_invitation: A new thread has just opened in the Open Conjectures section. The forum is active and members are posting throughout the day.
